name: Dots and Boxes
hook: Draw a line. Close a box. Go again.
how: Take turns drawing a line between two dots. Close a box to claim it and draw again; when every line is in, most boxes wins. Up to 4 play at once, bots fill the empty seats, and anyone else watches and joins the next game.
controls: Click or tap between two dots (on a phone, slide to the line and let go)
uses: The host's browser checks every line and keeps the turn timer; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill the seats nobody is in, so you can play alone, and a friend who joins takes over a bot.
Everyone sees the same lines and boxes, drawn in the moment they're played.
Most wins, shown after every game.
ideas: Make it a chalkboard with chalk sounds
